title: Man Seeking Woman
premise_summary: Man Seeking Woman is an American romantic comedy television series created by Simon Rich for FXX. It originally aired for 3 seasons from January 14, 2015, to March 8, 2017. The series is set in Chicago, about a naïve and soft-spoken man in his 20s named Josh Greenberg, who finds himself in several surrealist and awkward circumstances while trying to find love.
